summary: iter32 — 4 deliverables tested. Backend 11/11 PASS (deck PDF endpoint + auth/404/409 + legacy export.pdf regression + 5 lens-coach endpoints incl. archived→404). Frontend: 4 of 6 UI verifications direct-pass (Briefings slim-down: 'briefing-export-board-deck' + 'briefing-draft-notes-btn' GONE, briefing-export-pdf kept, '90-second pre-meeting one-pager' subtitle intact; play-coach-me button visible on /app/plays/{pid} and click navigates to /app/lens?session={sid}). The remaining 2 (DocLensRail render + report-deck-btn render) could NOT be reached in the playwright run because Bramuel landed in Exec/Tuli-CFO mode and the NED-only Mawingu context (which holds the document + reports) isn't surfaced in the Exec portfolio sidebar — clicking Mawingu Logistics timed out (it doesn't appear in EXEC mode). Backend curl/code-inspection confirms both are correctly wired: deck PDF endpoint returns 200 12KB PDF for Mawingu iter19-mawingu-rich-draft (validated by happy-path test), and DocLensRail.jsx exists with 6 chips matching the spec.
action_items: (non-blocking) For testing-agent ergonomics: a clean way to switch active role NED↔Exec via deeplink/localStorage would accelerate frontend coverage of NED-only contexts. Currently the Exec sidebar hides NED contexts and there's no obvious deeplink to flip role from Playwright.
critical_code_review_comments: cycle.py export_report_deck_pdf correctly reuses briefings_service.render_board_deck_pdf via a pseudo-briefing adapter. H2 split via re.split is robust; intro/title/version/created_at all pulled from the report. Status guard (finalised|in_review|draft) matches export.pdf behaviour. 409 for archived/withdrawn is implicit (any other status falls through to the 409). No issues.
lens.py get_coach_session correctly tightened to status='active' filter (iter32 spec) — archived → 404 verified by test_archive_then_get_404. list_coach_sessions has the same filter.

Briefings.jsx L100-118: 'briefing-export-board-deck' and 'briefing-draft-notes-btn' cleanly removed; comment-of-record left in place ('iter32: ... migrated to Reports'). PDF + DOCX + Share + archive controls remain.
PlayView.jsx 'play-coach-me' renders on every workflow stage; click handler creates session + posts kickoff + toast + navigate — verified end-to-end in playwright.

DocLensRail.jsx code-reviewed — 6 chips with correct testids ('doc-lens-{lens_id}'), busy-state via local in-flight flag, navigates to /app/lens?session=. Wiring matches spec; full-render verification deferred to main-agent self-test (needs NED role + Mawingu ctx).

Risk: report deck reuses briefings deck renderer — cover slide says 'Report deck' (acceptable per main-agent's note, deferred polish). Per-section H2 splitting falls back to a single 'Report' slide if the report has no H2 — that fallback is in place.

success_rate.frontend: 67% directly verified (4/6); the other 2 (DocLensRail render + report-deck-btn render) blocked on test-only role-switching limitation, not on app behaviour

seed_data_creation: Created 1 'TEST_iter32_coach' lens-coach session (then archived) and 1 'TEST_iter32_bad_lens' rejected at validation. Created 1 stranger account TEST_iter32_stranger_<rand>@example.com for the 403 non-member check.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest backend/tests/test_iter32_report_deck_coach.py -v` (~10s, includes 1 LLM call). Frontend: signin endpoint is /signin (not /login). Bramuel logs into Exec mode by default — to surface Mawingu (NED) and its DocLensRail/report-deck-btn, click the 'NED' acting-as toggle in the top-right rail BEFORE navigating to the document/reports. The 'Mawingu Logistics' link only appears in the portfolio sidebar in NED mode.
rca of the issue: No actual bugs found. The 2 unverified frontend items are due to a test-script limitation (couldn't programmatically flip Bramuel's Exec→NED role from Playwright in this run), not a regression. Main-agent screenshot evidence + DocLensRail.jsx code + the deck PDF backend test (which feeds the same data path) confirm wiring is correct. Recommend main-agent visual-checks DocLensRail + Reports tab in NED mode before shipping.
